title: CreateDestinationRequest
description: The request schema for the `createDestination` operation.

resourceSpecification.description: The information required to create a destination resource. Applications should use one resource type (sqs or eventBridge) per destination.

name.description: A developer-defined name to help identify this destination.

sqs.description: The information required to create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) queue destination.

eventBridge.description: The information required to create an Amazon EventBridge destination.

DestinationResourceSpecification.description: The information required to create a destination resource. Applications should use one resource type (sqs or eventBridge) per destination.

region.description: The AWS region in which you will be receiving the notifications.

accountId.description: The identifier for the AWS account that is responsible for charges related to receiving notifications.

EventBridgeResourceSpecification.description: The information required to create an Amazon EventBridge destination.

arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) associated with the SQS queue.

SqsResource.description: The information required to create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue destination.
